This beans plot is small, and for me fertilizer is costly, so I will not put chemical fertilizer there. I can use some compost or manure if I have enough, and I will plant improved seed if I can get it because it gives me a better harvest than local seed. I do not expect to spray chemicals, and I will depend on the rains, not irrigation. Most of the work will be done by my family, and I may hire a little labor only if we are delayed at planting or weeding.
